report.explanation: Mô hình LightGBM (dacn-lgbm-ember2018v2-5db192ec1bda) phân loại tĩnh: MALICIOUS (raw score 0.9997 so với threshold 0.8322; score >= threshold ⇒ malicious). Raw score KHÔNG phải xác suất đã hiệu chỉnh. Quan sát tĩnh về sections: 6 section, 3 section entropy≥7 (có thể do nén/đóng gói), 4 section vừa ghi vừa thực thi. Imports tĩnh: 2 thư viện, 2 hàm import (khả năng tĩnh, không phải hành vi đã chạy). Chuỗi tĩnh: 0 lần khớp URL, 0 khớp khóa registry, 14 MZ nhúng (chỉ là chỉ dấu tĩnh).
limitations: Chỉ phân tích tĩnh; không quan sát hành vi runtime/network/process.
Raw score chưa hiệu chỉnh; không phải xác suất.

assessment.rationale: The static analysis provides an authoritative prediction of malicious behavior based on the LightGBM model, which aligns with observable PE characteristics such as high entropy sections and stripped symbols.
limitations: Static analysis cannot confirm dynamic execution behavior or payload functionality.
The prediction is based on a replayed feature record rather than raw PE bytes, limiting absolute certainty.
assessment.explanation: While the static model strongly predicts malicious intent (score 0.9997), the lack of dynamic execution data and the nature of the replayed features prevent a definitive conclusion on actual behavior. Monitoring is recommended to observe runtime activity.

raw_proposal.reason: Static analysis is complete; the authoritative LightGBM prediction indicates malicious behavior, and supporting static features (high entropy sections, stripped symbols) are consistent with this label.
